test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. A single word will fit both the blanks.

His dog did not ________ when thieves were slashing the ________ of his precious tree.
solution:
The correct answer is '**bark**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**bark**" refers to the sound made by dogs. In this context, it indicates that the dog did not make any noise.
 
• The word "**bark**" refers to the main body or stalk of a plant. In this context, it indicates the part of the tree that was being damaged by the thieves.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *His dog did not bark__ when thieves were slashing the **__bark__** of his precious tree.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shout**: means to utter a loud cry, typically as an expression of a strong emotion.
 
• **Claw**: refers to a curved, pointed horny nail on each digit of the foot in birds, lizards, and some mammals.
